output.summary: Evergreen coniferous tree native to montane forests of southern Africa. Its grey-brown to reddish trunk becomes increasingly flaky with age, and some specimens in the Knysna-Amatole forests are over 1,000 years old. Its seed is edible but resinous, enclosed by a fleshy covering that ripens yellow and jelly-soft on female trees only every few years.
output.edibilityNote: The seed is edible but resinous.
